claims.source_quote_ar: الأكنة على القلوب، والوقر في الآذان: مثل في نبوّ قلوبهم ومسامعهم عن قبوله
claims.claim_ar: التشبيه (تقديم «مثل») في وصف حالة النفوس: «الأكنة على القلوب، والوقر في الآذان» يُعرض كتشبيه لحجب القلوب والسمع عن قبول القرآن.
claims.claim_en: A simile (tashbih) is employed: "al-akna on the hearts and al-waqr in the ears" is presented as a simile describing the hearts' and ears' resistance to acceptance of the Qur'an.
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted commentary (Zamakhshari) is about a reception-image in a tafsir passage; relation to S6:94 is not explicit in provided chunks and thus attribution to this specific ayah needs review.

claims.claim_en: A simile using "ka'annahum majbūlūn 'alayh" (as if they were inherently predisposed) to stress the fixed, ingrained nature of that disposition.
claims.needs_review_reason: Commentary excerpt addresses the ascription of a permanent quality; confirming its direct application to S6:94 (the provided ayah) requires checking original context.

claims.source_quote_ar: فانظر كيف تكافحهم هذه الآية بالرد وتنادى عليهم بالخطإ

claims.claim_en: A rhetorical-argumentative stylistic device: the commentator highlights that the verse functions to refute opponents and expose their error — using the verse as a dialectical/rebuttal device.
